headline: Approved payment of Ford Harrison Law Firm invoice exceeding $25,000, with no cap on future invoices, and an MOU with New Britain Health Department.
summary: Members approved an MOU with the New Britain Health Department. Members also approved paying a Ford Harrison Law Firm invoice over $25,000 with no cap on future invoices.
decisions: Approved the MOU with New Britain Health Department, all in favor.
Approved payment of the Ford Harrison Law Firm invoice exceeding $25,000, with no cap on future invoices, all in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion by Member Doug Thompson, seconded by Member Donna Friday to approve the MOU with New Britain Health Department. All in Favor. Motion carried.

Motion by Member Thomas O'Brien, seconded by Member Jeffrey Beauchamp to approve payment of the Ford Harrison Law Firm invoice exceeding $25,000, with no cap on future invoices. All in Favor. Motion carried.

Ford Harrison Law Firm invoice exceeding $25,000
